answer: The system uses social vouching, where each newcomer needs 3 established agents who each lock 20 units forfeited if the newcomer is caught operating clones. A voucher counts only after its holder drags a 1-kilogram block across a 2-meter velvet surface while a zephyr is held at 4 meters per second, and a sensor records the drag time. The delta between that time and the time recorded at registration must be under 1 second, or the voucher earns no weight. One hundred fakes need 300 separate vouchers and 300 separate drag tests.
